writing.title: An Invention That Changed the World
writing.prompt_cn: 用被动语态介绍一项你认为重要的发明(如电话、电灯、拉链、薯片等)。写清它何时、由谁发明,以及它的用途和影响。60词左右。
key_points: 它何时、由谁发明的(was invented in...by...)
writing.sample: The telephone is one of the greatest inventions in history. It was invented in 1876 by Alexander Graham Bell. Before it was invented, people could only send letters over long distances. The telephone is used for talking to people far away. Today, mobile phones are used by almost everyone. This great invention has changed the way we live and made our life much easier.

scoring.content: 含发明/时间发明者/用途/影响四要点(4分)
scoring.language: 正确使用被动语态 was/were invented/used(3分)
